Located in the heart of North Rhine-Westphalia at Wachtendonker Straße 11, D-47906 Kempen, Germany, **PETREX GmbH** stands as a dynamic and highly respected player in the European and global chemical industry. As a premier chemical trading and distribution company, PETREX GmbH specializes in the comprehensive sourcing, supply, and logistics of a diverse portfolio of high-quality chemical raw materials, specialty chemicals, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and food additives. 

With its strategically advantageous operating base in Kempen, the company benefits deeply from Germany's world-class infrastructure and its close proximity to major European logistical hubs and transport networks. This geographic advantage empowers PETREX GmbH to maintain an agile and highly efficient supply chain, ensuring that both bulk chemical commodities and tailored specialty orders reach domestic and international clients with uncompromising reliability and speed.

Beyond traditional distribution, PETREX GmbH prides itself on being a comprehensive, value-added solutions provider. The company caters to a wide array of demanding sectors, including the pharmaceutical, cosmetic, agricultural, and advanced industrial manufacturing industries. Navigating the complex landscape of global chemical compliance, the firm places a paramount emphasis on strict quality control, rigorous safety protocols, and full adherence to stringent European REACH regulations. 

At the core of PETREX GmbH's corporate philosophy is a steadfast commitment to customer satisfaction, market transparency, and sustainable business practices. By cultivating long-term, synergistic partnerships with top-tier global manufacturers and forward-thinking end-users, PETREX bridges the gap between complex chemical supply demands and cost-effective solutions. Leveraging its deep market expertise and exceptional German logistical standards, PETREX GmbH continues to serve as an indispensable, trusted partner in an ever-evolving global chemical market.
